eta_increase_seconds.description: Additional time, in seconds, to add to the displayed delivery ETA while the restaurant is busy. Must be non-negative; defaults to 0 if omitted.

start_time.description: When the busy interval begins, as an RFC-3339 / ISO-8601 UTC timestamp.

end_time.description: When the busy interval ends, as an RFC-3339 / ISO-8601 UTC timestamp. Must be after start_time.
